title: The Mingling, the Molding of Adam, and the Eyes Opened in the Cosmos
description: The opening fragment carries the reader from the cosmic war between Light and Darkness, through the mingling that resulted, down into the molding of the first natural man, ending at the moment Adam eats and his eyes open. Read correspondentially, this is the standard story of how the proprium comes to be formed and how the natural understanding is first awakened — not in pure light, but in the mingled state. It establishes the foundational situation that everything in the book will work to resolve.
